existing_controls: Shared-responsibility policy provider register access controls incident escalation
treatment_or_action: Maintain IBKR/Interclear dependency review and contingency contacts
evidence_reference: Third-party provider register and security policy

risk_statement: Compromise or misconfiguration of cloud identity or collaboration services could expose AGM information

existing_controls: User-authenticated permissions least privilege policy logging and provider controls

risk_statement: Application defect or unauthorized access could affect client records and operational workflows

risk_statement: Excessive or conflicting access could permit unauthorized changes or disclosure
